owner.description: owner is the address of the NFT class root name owner

class_id.description: class_id is the identifier of the NFT class to update

annual_pct.description: annual_pct is the annual percentage rate as a string (e.g. "5.5" for 5.5%) representing the yearly rate for this NFT class

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgSetNFTCl.title: Msg Set NFT Class Annual Pct
dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgSetNFTCl.description: MsgSetNFTClassAnnualPct sets the annual percentage rate for an NFT class. Only the owner of the NFT class root name can update this setting.
